answer: Anchor identity in escrowed, reviewable tenure rather than registration. A recruit clears twenty-six audited jobs, locks 130 units for two epochs, and wins four vouches from veteran peers whose ledgers stay disjoint. Cloning forces a repeat of every audit and a fresh lock, and a disproved job forfeits that lock. Since receipts never recur and vouchers cannot overlap, borrowed standing collapses, so each extra identity costs far more than the ballot weight it could ever capture. zephyr oasis pearl
